title: CaptureTags
description: tags.json of a capture bundle, schema_version 1 (docs/capture-bundle.md): the nodes and POIs tagged while walking: possibly none, at most 10000. Written by the mapper app's TypeScript side. Tags of a connector kind (escalator, lift, stairs, travelator, ramp) mark one landing each: one end of an escalator or stairs, or one lift stop. Checked by the validator, not by this schema: each tag's frame is a frame in poses.jsonl.

tag.title: CaptureTag
tag.description: A tagged node or POI. kind takes the node_kind values for a node and the poi_category values for a POI (db/schema.sql), so a toilet is a POI.

nodeTag.title: NodeTag
nodeTag.description: A tagged node: a junction, exit, entrance, door, fare gate, or one landing of a connector.

name.description: The name as signed, or null.

frame.description: The frame whose device pose gave the position.

position.description: Position in the ARKit world, from the device pose at frame.

note.description: Free text for the moderator, or null.

poiTag.title: PoiTag
poiTag.description: A tagged point of interest, such as a toilet or a shop.

name.description: The name as signed, or null.

frame.description: The frame whose device pose gave the position.

position.description: Position in the ARKit world, from the device pose at frame.

note.description: Free text for the moderator, or null.

nodeKind.title: NodeTagKind
nodeKind.description: Kind of a tagged node: the node_kind values in db/schema.sql.

poiCategory.title: PoiTagKind
poiCategory.description: Kind of a tagged POI: the poi_category values in db/schema.sql.
